api.request_contract: request_contract(plan_path)->(contract,plan); standard library JSON/source hashes/file stats only
api.run: run(plan_path,output_path=None)->summary; automatic exact completed reuse and own last.pt resume

release_requirements: plan.source_sha256 contains only exact new module SHA
root_review.passed=true and root_review.source_sha256 equals the new module SHA string

contract.digest: contract.science_recipe_sha256; no extra mandatory root marker digest

model.architecture: 7->64 ReLU->64 ReLU->1 logit; FP32/TF32 without autocast
model.output: Fixed raw FP64 VM q times FP64 tanh(logit); q is not calibrated
model.inputs: Exact inherited TRAIN3 sigma6 mean/std plus validity; invalid normalized sigma forced zero; no target input

training.loss: Full-case signed field energy loss plus 0.1 energy-weighted softplus derived-sign supervision; no denominator floor
training.first_actual_guard: All named head gradients present and finite, global norm>0; shape and public count recorded
training.checkpoint: last.pt: model,Adam,step,case schedule,Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/all CUDA RNG,state; persistent state.json/read ledger
training.budget: Training120s/stage180s cumulative across resume; atomic finite checkpoint/finalization overshoot disclosed; no new case update after budget

DEV_policy: Both fixed60 allN prediction_MPa.npy and logit.npy records committed before either DEV cached original signed-S read; no DEV best

summary_schema.cases: Five fixed keys; per-case metrics/costs/read_receipt, missing values null
summary_schema.gate: selection_gate.passed; actual60, each DEV signedL2<0.25, mean hotspotL2<0.25, each energy signerror<=0.05, finite complete metrics
summary_schema.receipts: Persistent actual GT/stress/TRAIN/DEV/sigma/valid attempted and completed reads; own checkpoint/head/prediction reads separate; external forbidden reads explicitly zero
summary_schema.negative: Outer completed means bounded scientific screen ended; budget/incomplete/null cannot pass; runtime exception failed retains checkpoint

cold_cost: Inherited physical GT-free cold + sigma recovery + validity incidence + actual necessary cached input/normalization/q + full single-request metadata/startup/headload + inference/persistence; unneeded xyz/25/cloud preparation excluded; fresh combined cold not remeasured; cached increment/training oneoff separate
narrow_root_review: request_contract/cache provenance; prepare_case/fixed q; actual_stage full-case energy loss and resume; predict/cached_array DEV transaction; metrics/selection_gate; Clock/run budgets and cold components
scope: Only this new module and this ready written; no original source,plan,reporter,coordinator,cache,checkpoint modified
